1 Principal AI Engineer Your Tasks
 * Being part of SQUER means driving solutions in client projects and actively shaping SQUER with your knowledge.
 * Lead our clients in their AI adoption, develop their AI vision and target picture, and translate both into a concrete, prioritised transformation roadmap.
 * You will support several teams by solving complex challenges of both frontend and backend development.
 * You will be responsible for introducing or improving the AI-usage in the SDLC across the engineering teams of our clients and successfully deliver software solutions together.
 * You can communicate openly and are a team player.
 * You are actively involved in all phases of software development in an interdisciplinary manner and are happy to share your knowledge with your colleagues as a sparring partner and coach.
 * You are an active member of mostly agile SCRUM teams and spread SQUER culture with the aim of constant improvement.

Your Qualifications
 * Your experience and big-picture-thinking allows you to create solutions that generate a sustainable impact for our clients. 
 * You are a rolemodel in the usage of AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality and you are proficient in guiding teams in their AI adoption.
 * You have several years of experience within software architecture, cloud-native development and containerization (Docker or Kubernetes). You would like to deepen your knowledge in this field.
 * You have solid knowledge of frontend and backend development and relevant trends within this area excite you.
 * You have a hands-on mentality and are proficient in one or more programming languages in the Java ( Java, Kotlin, Scala, Clojure, ...), Javascript (Javascript, Typescript) or cloud-native environment (Rust, Go, ...).
 * You continuously improve the AI-adoption along the entire SDLC, resolve bottlenecks and feel passionate about enabling software teams in all their disciplines.
 * Trainings and development of your skills are highly important to you. Moreover, you enjoy passing on acquired knowledge.
 * You are fluent in English and German (written and spoken) in order to communicate in the best way possible with colleagues and partners.

Your Benefits

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

 
We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 95.000 and € 105.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595
jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.
 * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications.
 * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous.
 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
